pages.title: Hopf Fibration
pages.text: A three-sphere unwound into circles, each circle linked with every other exactly once. Hopf found it in 1931, and it appears in physics from magnetic monopoles to quantum states. It is beautiful and endlessly twisting.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining a hypersphere fragment with quaternions and compactified circles in the Tesseract Assembler, I found the three-sphere fibred into linked circles. I also found these in the Ordinal Spire.
